title: Fast auction trades earned money
finding: 16 closed CAS trades recorded ₹2,791.75 gross and ₹1,709.36 after matched broker charges. One expiry session does not establish repeatability.
action: Keep this mechanism separate from ordinary-session signals and compare actual fills, costs and holding times.

title: A profitable day did not protect the next one
finding: The published-PCR trailing strategy recorded one closed loss: ₹2,665 gross and ₹2,725.78 after matched broker charges. It remains outside the funded roster.
action: Retain the loss in history. A different signal and holding period cannot inherit the auction strategy's success.

title: Four fills; three input-loss exits
finding: Four trades earned ₹367.25 gross; observed cash rose ₹158.61. Three exits followed missing fresh inputs, and seven strategy entries did not fill. Final itemized charges remain unavailable.
action: Isolate futures delivery, record receipt-time evidence continuously during open sessions, and retain exit reasons and daily outcomes. Verify the effect in the next live session.
